changes.before: No specific data center project is proposed or approved within Houston city limits; concern centers on a proposed AIDEA industrial/energy district on state land bordering Houston, Willow, and Meadow Lakes that lists data centers among possible future uses.
changes.after: Alaska News reported, in material retrieved November 5, 2026, that Senator George Rauscher described AIDEA officials as saying no data center was planned while data centers remained a possible use of proposed state land about two miles north of Houston. Whether any specific data center is proposed or approved within Houston city limits, and whether Ordinance 26-20 applies to any particular project, remain unverified.
changes.reason: Report attributes the officials statement through Senator Rauscher, not directly to officials as a reporter-observed statement. The broad existing citywide negative is not established by a statement about a separate proposed state land transfer; no complete city permit or project census was reviewed. Preserve this attribution chain and observation date. The report does not establish land lies within Houston or applicability of the ordinance.
